critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error on happy path. Root cause: brief_contract_routes.py:241 _resolve_template_id() does `t.get('title')` but BreezeDocs list_templates() returns items that are strings (titles), not dicts. AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get'. Blocks entire Phase J brief-approval→contract-dispatch flow when BreezeDocs is in LIVE mode.

action_items: Fix brief_contract_routes._resolve_template_id (~line 241) to handle BreezeDocs templates that come back as plain strings. Suggested: `title = (t if isinstance(t, str) else (t.get('title') or '')).lower()` and `return int(t['id']) if isinstance(t, dict) else None`. Or better — fix BreezeDocsClient.list_templates() to always normalize each row to {id, title, ...}. After fix, rerun test_iteration_28b::test_phase_j_dispatch_happy_path_and_idempotency to confirm: project_files contract row + 'Contract & Invoice Sent' milestone + breezedocs_proposals row with linked_brief_id all get created; second POST returns the cached result without dupes.

rca of the issue: Phase J dispatch-contract 500: in /app/backend/brief_contract_routes.py line 234-244 (`_resolve_template_id`), the code does `for t in res.get('data') or []: title = (t.get('title') or '').lower()` assuming every row is a dict. BreezeDocs LIVE returns rows where at least one element is a plain string, triggering `AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get'`. Reproduction: seed an approved brief (`status='approved'`, `awaiting_contract_dispatch=True`) and POST /api/admin/briefs/{id}/dispatch-contract as founder → 500. Fix: normalize each template row, e.g. `title = (t.get('title') if isinstance(t, dict) else t) or ''; tid = t.get('id') if isinstance(t, dict) else None; if tid is not None and (needle in title.lower()): return int(tid)`. Equivalently fix it at the BreezeDocsClient.list_templates() layer so all callers get a consistent [{id, title, ...}] list.
